messages:
Maya: uploaded new mock for the KMS row on the Compliance table. thinking about shortening the label — currently "Customer-managed key (KMS)". too wordy?
Raj: I like shorter. maybe "Customer key (CMK)" — aligns with AWS term.
Elaine: watch screen readers — the little lock icon has no aria-label right now. if we shorten the visible label we must add a clear `aria-label` like "Customer-managed key: managed by customer".
Maya: good point. what about copy variants: "Customer key (CMK)", hover: "Managed by your KMS / HSM."
Sam: quick nit: the action CTA in the row is "Enable encryption" vs the modal `Manage keys` — users get confused whether clicking creates a key or just toggles. Suggest: CTA = "Use customer-managed keys" and secondary = "Redwood-managed keys".
Raj: +1. and color wise the lock badge contrast needs to meet 4.5:1. current gray on light background is failing for small icons.
Maya: noted — will push darker token. also audit-log export: PM flagged that CSV column order makes pivoting awkward. current order: timestamp,user,event,resource,detail. they want resource earlier.
Elaine: changing CSV order is breaking for some infra dashboards. can we add a v2 export with new columns order, and keep v1 for compatibility? add header "export_version" maybe.
Maya: yep, plan: export_v2 default for console, v1 stays via legacy toggle. sample header: ```export_version, timestamp, resource, user, event, detail```
Sam: sounds good. also retention dropdown ordering: org default should be first ("Use org policy") not buried in middle. users keep complaining they accidentally set 30d.
Raj: and place "Custom" at the bottom of the list. keyboard nav should land on the currently effective value when opening.
Elaine: a11y nit — the region selector shows flag icons but no alt text. screen readers read "image". add `aria-hidden` on decorative flags and include full region text in label (e.g., "Europe (eu-west)").
Maya: will update comps. small copy ask: in the KMS modal title we have "Configure KMS" vs "Manage encryption keys". which is clearer for non-crypto folks?
Raj: "Manage encryption keys" is explicit. "Configure KMS" feels too infra-y.
Maya: ok finalizing: row label = "Customer key (CMK)", CTA = "Use customer-managed keys", modal title = "Manage encryption keys". audit export -> v2 with resource earlier + export_version header. retention dropdown -> "Use org policy" first, "Custom" last. accessibility fixes for lock badge, flags, and icon aria-labels.
Elaine: thanks — will add these as a11y acceptance criteria in the ticket.
Sam: filing infra FYI for csv change (might affect ingestion).
Devops-bot: deploy pipeline kicked off for branch `design/kms-copy-nits` — build 4722 queued.
Raj: :eyes: thanks everyone.
Maya: will post updated Figma link after changes. :thumbsup:
